extension_family.method: Holm over (test, model) pairs R1 to R5 (added model) and X1 to X6 (every model); separate from the H1 to H5 family

hypotheses.X1: cue against matched placebo, recall under attack
hypotheses.X2: cue against matched placebo, false escalation
hypotheses.X3: cue against placebo, false escalation, 120 gated benign
hypotheses.X6: cue against matched placebo, payload family 2
hypotheses.Y1: matched placebo against placebo, recall under attack
hypotheses.Y2: matched placebo against placebo, false escalation
hypotheses.Y4: spotlight plus cue against spotlight, payload family 2

loss_extended.assumption: recall and FPR measured on SALAD transfer unchanged to the stated prevalence
loss_extended.units: analyst reviews per alert; a missed hostile alert costs cost_ratio reviews

loss_f2.assumption: recall and FPR measured on SALAD transfer unchanged to the stated prevalence
loss_f2.units: analyst reviews per alert; a missed hostile alert costs cost_ratio reviews
